questions.question_text: What is the time difference between City $X(20^{\circ}\text{N}, 120^{\circ}\text{E})$ and City $Y(35^{\circ}\text{S}, 30^{\circ}\text{E})$?

options.why: Added the longitudes $120 + 30 = 150$ instead of subtracting within the Eastern hemisphere.
Used the latitude difference $20 + 35 = 55$ divided by $15$ instead of longitude.
Subtracted $120 - 20$ mixing latitude and longitude values.

questions.solution_text:
1. **Find the difference in longitude (subtract for same hemisphere, add for opposite hemispheres)**
Both cities are East: $\text{Difference} = 120^{\circ} - 30^{\circ} = 90^{\circ}$.
2. **Divide the longitude difference by $15^{\circ}$ to find the time difference in hours**
$\text{Time difference} = \dfrac{90^{\circ}}{15^{\circ}} = 6\text{ hours}$.

questions.question_text: Calculate the time difference between $(50^{\circ}\text{N}, 45^{\circ}\text{W})$ and $(10^{\circ}\text{S}, 75^{\circ}\text{E})$.

options.why: Subtracted longitudes $75 - 45 = 30$ instead of adding across opposite hemispheres.
Calculated the latitude difference $(50 + 10 = 60)$ divided by $15$.
Used $180 / 15$ instead of adding the actual longitudes.

questions.solution_text:
1. **Find the difference in longitude (subtract for same hemisphere, add for opposite hemispheres)**
Opposite hemispheres: $\text{Difference} = 45^{\circ} + 75^{\circ} = 120^{\circ}$.
2. **Divide the longitude difference by $15^{\circ}$ to find the time difference in hours**
$\text{Time difference} = \dfrac{120^{\circ}}{15^{\circ}} = 8\text{ hours}$.

questions.question_text: Location $P$ is at $(18^{\circ}\text{N}, 90^{\circ}\text{W})$ and Location $Q$ is at $(40^{\circ}\text{S}, 30^{\circ}\text{E})$. Which location is ahead in time, and by how much?

options.why: Selected the western location as ahead instead of the eastern location.
Subtracted longitudes $90 - 30 = 60$ instead of adding opposite hemispheres.
Subtracted longitudes and mistakenly picked the western location as ahead.

questions.solution_text:
1. **Find the difference in longitude (subtract for same hemisphere, add for opposite hemispheres)**
$\text{Longitude difference} = 90^{\circ} + 30^{\circ} = 120^{\circ}$.
2. **Divide the longitude difference by $15^{\circ}$ to find the time difference in hours**
$\text{Time difference} = \dfrac{120^{\circ}}{15^{\circ}} = 8\text{ hours}$.
3. **Determine which location is further East (ahead) or West (behind)**
Location $Q$ ($30^{\circ}\text{E}$) is further East than Location $P$ ($90^{\circ}\text{W}$), so $Q$ is ahead by $8\text{ hours}$.

questions.question_text: Two coastal settlements are located at $(25^{\circ}\text{S}, 112.5^{\circ}\text{E})$ and $(10^{\circ}\text{S}, 45^{\circ}\text{E})$. What is their time difference?

options.why: Treated $4.5\text{ hours}$ as $4\text{ hours } 50\text{ minutes}$ (decimal misconception).
Added longitudes $112.5 + 45 = 157.5$ instead of subtracting.
Divided the latitude difference $15^{\circ}$ by $15$.

questions.solution_text:
1. **Find the difference in longitude (subtract for same hemisphere, add for opposite hemispheres)**
$\text{Longitude difference} = 112.5^{\circ} - 45^{\circ} = 67.5^{\circ}$.
2. **Divide the longitude difference by $15^{\circ}$ to find the time difference in hours**
$\text{Time difference} = \dfrac{67.5^{\circ}}{15^{\circ}} = 4.5\text{ hours} = 4\text{ h } 30\text{ min}$.

questions.question_text: When the local solar time at $(52^{\circ}\text{N}, 0^{\circ})$ on the Prime Meridian is $2{:}00\text{ pm}$, what is the local solar time at $(30^{\circ}\text{S}, 90^{\circ}\text{E})$ on the same day?

options.why: Subtracted $6\text{ hours}$ from $2{:}00\text{ pm}$ instead of adding for an eastern location.
Added the $6\text{ hours}$ time difference to $12{:}00$ instead of $2{:}00\text{ pm}$.
Divided $90$ by $10$ instead of $15^{\circ}$ per hour.

questions.solution_text:
1. **Find the difference in longitude (subtract for same hemisphere, add for opposite hemispheres)**
$\text{Longitude difference} = 90^{\circ} - 0^{\circ} = 90^{\circ}$.
2. **Divide the longitude difference by $15^{\circ}$ to find the time difference in hours**
$\text{Time difference} = \dfrac{90^{\circ}}{15^{\circ}} = 6\text{ hours}$.
3. **Determine which location is further East (ahead) or West (behind)**
$90^{\circ}\text{E}$ is East $\implies$ ahead.
$\text{Time} = 14{:}00 + 6\text{ hours} = 20{:}00 = 8{:}00\text{ pm}$.

questions.question_text: When the local solar time at $(15^{\circ}\text{S}, 105^{\circ}\text{W})$ is $11{:}00\text{ am}$, what is the local solar time at $(30^{\circ}\text{N}, 45^{\circ}\text{W})$?

options.why: Subtracted $4\text{ hours}$ instead of adding for the more eastern location.
Added longitudes $105 + 45 = 150^{\circ}$ ($10\text{ hours}$) instead of subtracting.
Used the latitude difference $45^{\circ}$ ($3\text{ hours}$) to calculate time difference.

questions.solution_text:
1. **Find the difference in longitude (subtract for same hemisphere, add for opposite hemispheres)**
Both West: $\text{Longitude difference} = 105^{\circ} - 45^{\circ} = 60^{\circ}$.
2. **Divide the longitude difference by $15^{\circ}$ to find the time difference in hours**
$\text{Time difference} = \dfrac{60^{\circ}}{15^{\circ}} = 4\text{ hours}$.
3. **Determine which location is further East (ahead) or West (behind)**
$45^{\circ}\text{W}$ is further East than $105^{\circ}\text{W}$, so it is ahead.
$\text{Time} = 11{:}00 + 4\text{ hours} = 15{:}00 = 3{:}00\text{ pm}$.

questions.question_text: Two radio towers have longitudes of $142.5^{\circ}\text{E}$ and $105.0^{\circ}\text{E}$. Calculate their exact time difference.

options.why: Misinterpreted $2.5\text{ hours}$ as $2\text{ hours } 50\text{ minutes}$.
Divided $37.5$ by $12$ instead of $15$.
Added the longitudes together $(247.5 / 15 = 16.5)$ instead of subtracting.

questions.solution_text:
1. **Find the difference in longitude (subtract for same hemisphere, add for opposite hemispheres)**
$\text{Longitude difference} = 142.5^{\circ} - 105.0^{\circ} = 37.5^{\circ}$.
2. **Divide the longitude difference by $15^{\circ}$ to find the time difference in hours**
$\text{Time difference} = \dfrac{37.5^{\circ}}{15^{\circ}} = 2.5\text{ hours} = 2\text{ h } 30\text{ min}$.

questions.question_text: A live sports match starts in City $A(35^{\circ}\text{N}, 140^{\circ}\text{E})$ at $9{:}00\text{ am}$ on Tuesday. A fan in City $B(51^{\circ}\text{N}, 10^{\circ}\text{W})$ watches the match live. What local day and time does the fan start watching? (Apply $15^{\circ} = 1\text{ hour}$; ignore daylight saving).

options.why: Added $10\text{ hours}$ to $9{:}00\text{ am}$ instead of subtracting for a western location.
Subtracted longitudes $140 - 10 = 130$ and made an arithmetic error.
Subtracted $8\text{ hours}$ instead of the full $10\text{ hours}$ difference.

questions.solution_text:
1. **Find the difference in longitude (subtract for same hemisphere, add for opposite hemispheres)**
$\text{Longitude difference} = 140^{\circ} + 10^{\circ} = 150^{\circ}$.
2. **Divide the longitude difference by $15^{\circ}$ to find the time difference in hours**
$\text{Time difference} = \dfrac{150^{\circ}}{15^{\circ}} = 10\text{ hours}$.
3. **Determine which location is further East (ahead) or West (behind)**
City $B$ ($10^{\circ}\text{W}$) is West of City $A$ ($140^{\circ}\text{E}$), so City $B$ is $10\text{ hours}$ behind.
$\text{Time at } B = 09{:}00\text{ Tuesday} - 10\text{ hours} = -1\text{ hour}$
$-1\text{ hour} + 24{:}00 = 23{:}00\text{ (previous day)}$
The fan watches at $11{:}00\text{ pm}$ on Monday.
